text: In 2023 Dufry acquired Autogrill: by 1 July 2023 Dufry held 96.3858% of Autogrill's share capital and could proceed with the squeeze-out and the delisting of Autogrill. The Dufry group now operates as Avolta AG, which still runs the Autogrill brand in Italy.
short: Autogrill was fully acquired and delisted by Dufry (now Avolta) in 2023.
